              WHERE conname = 'V2Terminal_state_check_5a2da7a7'

    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE public."Terminal" RENAME CONSTRAINT "V2Terminal_state_check_5a2da7a7" TO "Terminal_state_check_5a2da7a7"';

label: Recreate the append-only guard function in public

precheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT relkind FROM pg_class WHERE oid = to_regclass('public."Event"')) = 'r' AS "result"

execute.description: create public.Event_append_only() raising on any row mutation
execute.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public."Event_append_only"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Event is append-only: % refused for thread % seq %', TG_OP, OLD."threadId", OLD."seq"
    USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';
END;
$$

label: Guard public."Event" against UPDATE and DELETE before the old trigger goes

precheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT relkind FROM pg_class WHERE oid = to_regclass('public."Event"')) = 'r' AS "result"

execute.description: drop any previous trigger of the new name
execute.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "Event_append_only" ON public."Event"

execute.description: create the BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE row trigger on public."Event"
execute.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER "Event_append_only"
BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON public."Event"
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public."Event_append_only"()

label: Drop the v2-era trigger and its function

execute.description: drop the trigger that followed the table out of v2
execute.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "V2Event_append_only" ON public."Event"

execute.description: drop the v2 function
execute.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS v2."V2Event_append_only"()
